notes.title: 12 Days of the Spiral!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44049597/de12b303f98b6774c1607ccceda46e4837ff4f49.png

Happy Holidays! 🎁

From now through December 13th, KingsIsle is celebrating the 12 Days of the Spiral! Enjoy FREE MEMBERSHIP and a new surprise in store each day for your Pirate! Don't forget to check every day so you don't miss out!

Day 1
New Charity Two Turtle Doves Mount!

On the first day of the Spiral, KingsIsle gave to me… Two Turtle Doves? 🐢🕊️

The new Charity Two Turtle Doves Mount is now available in the Online Cart! A portion of the proceeds for this bundle will be donated to Creative Action and AbleGamers.

See Day 1 >>


Day 2
New Winter Witch Pack!

Feel the brisk breeze of winter! ❄️

The Winter Witch Pack is now available in the Crown Shop. Don’t miss out on chilling new items and a FREE pack for everyone! 

See Day 2 >>  


Day 3
Free Giveaway!

Make your house merrier! 🏡

Use today's code to get some festive housing items and a chance at a Yule Mule Mount! 

Get Free Gift >>  

Day 4
Winter Wonderland Contest!

Help make the holidays magical! ✨

Today kicks off our annual winter artwork contest! Put your creative spirit to the test by creating a Winter Wonderland scene including elements from Pirate101. Great prizes await!  

See Day 4 >>

notes.title: Pirate MMORPG sets sail for the afterlife in spooky new update
notes.content:
Pirates are cool and remain cool, no matter how much various overstayed-their-welcome movie franchises try to make pirates uncool. There's something about the jolly roger, the yo-ho-ho-ing, and leaping aboard enemy ships that just sings to our hearts. They're cool and so it's always a wonder that we don't have more pirate games. Thankfully games like Pirate101 continue to fly the black flag and with its next major update, that flag is about to get a little bit darker.
Read the rest of the story...
